image_description: A large, silver-grey airship (dirigible) hovering low over a body of water with a tree line in the background. The airship features a long, cigar-shaped envelope with text and graphics on the side, a gondola suspended beneath the front-mid section, and tail fins at the rear. The sky is overcast.
